blocks.html: The Dot Property Philippines Awards is pleased to honor Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC) as Best Developer for the second year in a row. This year’s award commends RLC for its Robinsons Communities brand which develops affordable and quality condominium projects.

Developments by RLC under the Robinsons Communities brand are not only reasonably priced, but they also offer residents an enjoyable living experience. Robinsons Communities takes this promise to heart as it leads and works tirelessly to create affordable and high-quality condominiums while at the same time providing homeowners accessibility and lifestyle conveniences.

"Our objective is offering quality living experience at a reasonable price that is well received by the market.” Henry L. Yap, Business Unit General Manager, Robinsons Luxuria, Residences & Communities, explains.

Dot Property Philippines Country Manager Tanya Yu-Peralta was joined by Dot Property Editor-in-Chief Cheyenne Hollis to present Robinsons Communities with its award for Best Developer (Affordable Condominiums). The pair congratulated RLC for its hard work and commitment to excellence.
“This affirmation shows the continued support given buy our homebuyers as evidence by this back-to-back recognition. ” Yap concludes.
